description: A deeply conversational task teaching preschoolers the difference between left and right.

engage.speech_start: Hello my wonderful friends! I am so excited to see you today! We have a super fun and very important mission. Today, we are going to learn all about our left side and our right side! Are you ready to go on an adventure together? Let's go!
engage.speech_end: Okay, let's think really hard for a second. Do you remember which hand is your left hand? Show me how you raise it all the way up high into the playful sky!
engage.description: Connect with prior knowledge. Watch the fun introductory video.

explore.speech_start: Okay superstars, it is time to move our bodies around! Stand straight up on your feet and let's explore together. Follow along with exactly what I do!
explore.description: Students observe objects and physically identify directions.
explore.activity_description: Raise your left hand, and then your right hand, and show your teacher!
explore.speech_end: Wow, you did such an awesome job exploring with me! You are amazing! Now let's head right back to our lesson and learn some more.

explain.speech_start: Here is a fun little trick just for you! Hold both of your hands out right in front of you. Look at them really closely! The hand that naturally makes an 'L' shape with your thumb and pointer finger... is your left hand! See the L? That means Left! And the other one is your right hand!
explain.speech_end: Now you know the magic secret of what left and right means. You are getting so smart, I can't even believe it!
explain.description: Robot deeply explains the concept using the 'L' shape trick on the hands.

elaborate.speech_start: Hmm, let's look at this one a little closer together. Remember our fun trick? The hand that naturally makes an 'L' shape with your thumb and pointer finger is your left hand! Let's use that trick now. I know you can do this! Can you help me find the absolutely correct answer?
elaborate.speech_end: Excellent! You are learning so fast, I am so incredibly proud of you!
elaborate.task_description: Look at the pictures. Which one of these images shows the left hand?

evaluate.speech_start: Alright, my brilliant superstar, it is time to show everybody what you know! Look very carefully at the screen and take all the time you need.
evaluate.speech_end: Wow! You are absolutely fantastic! I am cheering so loud for you!
evaluate.task_description: Can you show me which beautiful arrow points perfectly to the right?
